texts.label: A
fehler: Mit rund 370 Wörtern deutlich über der Vorgabe von etwa 250
"Your mother said it sometimes ... Near the end. She was proud of you." – Die Auflösung ist eine Enthüllung, gegen die Vorgabe der Zurückhaltung
"felt the words land somewhere under her ribs and stay there" – abgegriffene Gefühlsformel
"watched it until she could breathe" – Klischee-Schluss
"walked the fourth-floor corridor" vs. "The chapel was off the lobby" – räumlicher Sprung ohne Übergang

texts.label: B
fehler: "From somewhere beyond the chapel came the uneven knock of a trolley wheel." – leicht formelhaftes Krankenhausgeräusch
"She could have asked his name, then called upstairs." – erklärt, was die Szene schon zeigt
"She noticed that his shoes were dry" – "noticed" als Filterverb schwächt das Bild

texts.label: C
fehler: "second row of padded chairs" vs. "the blonde wood of the pew" – Widerspruch in der Ausstattung
"His voice was flat, grated by lack of sleep." – schiefe Formulierung
"the bright misery of the ICU waiting room. The chapel was for daytime grief." – zu gesuchte Pointen
"grey, porous skin of a heavy smoker" – Typisierung
"it hadn't rained since Tuesday" plus "slush" – das Rätsel wird überdeutlich ausgestellt

texts.label: D
fehler: "**Second Pew**" – Überschrift gehört nicht zum geforderten reinen Szenentext
"His hands were folded the way people fold them when they've been told to keep still." – Vergleichsmuster, das in solchen Texten häufig vorkommt
"There had been so many wives, so many dressings." – leicht rhetorische Wiederholung

texts.label: E
fehler: "# The Chapel at 4 A.M." – Überschrift gegen die Vorgabe "nur Buchtext"
"used her name like a key earlier and she had not liked the door it opened" – überkonstruierte Metapher
"the necessary arithmetic of forgetting" – erklärende Sentenz statt Szene
"I figured anyone who did that must know how much it matters." – die Figur spricht das Thema aus
"the way you'd look at a vending machine that had taken your money" – bemühter Vergleich

texts.label: F
fehler: "A man occupied the back pew." – steifes Verb
"In the glass, the cleaner's machine passed again" – unklarer Bezug (welches Glas?)
"Somewhere above them, a monitor gave a single brief beep, then stopped." – formelhaftes Atmosphäresignal
"thin as a coin" – unpräziser Vergleich für eine sich ausbreitende Pfütze
